description: Get short interest data for a company including short volume, short ratio, days to cover, and short percent of float. Use when analyzing bearish sentiment or potential short squeeze setups. 🔴 "shortInterestPercent" null ALWAYS carries "shortInterestPercentReason" (since 2026-10-04): "float_not_point" = the float on record is a snapshot BOUND or ESTIMATE (<= / >= / ~), and a percent-of-float is never struck off a bound — do NOT divide "shortInterest" by a ceiling, floor or estimate from get_float yourself; "float_unavailable" = no float of any kind on record; "short_pct_of_float_unreconciled" = a point float existed but the ratio was implausible or the split basis could not be resolved; "float_class_scope_mismatch" = the float on record POOLS more than one separately listed share class (e.g. Class A + Class D) while short interest is reported for this symbol's class only — do NOT divide "shortInterest" by get_float's figure yourself for that ticker. A null percent is NOT MEASURED, never 0%.
name: get_short_interest
title: Get Short Interest
